description: This is a test class for the PurgeCandidateAPI within the OrangeHRM Maintenance API plugin. It contains test methods for validating API endpoints related to purge candidate operations, such as delete and get all, as well as validation rules and service access.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateAPITest
